062@Command({ "tne", "myeco", "ecomenu", "ecomin", "ecoadmin", "ecomanage", "theneweconomy" })
063@Description("Admin.Main.Description")

065
066  public static boolean restoreOld(@Nullable final Integer extraction) {
067
068    return LegacyAccountRestorer.restore(extraction, AdminCommand::get);
069  }
070
071  protected static UUID get(final String name) {
072
073    final OfflinePlayer player = Bukkit.getServer().getOfflinePlayerIfCached(name);
074    if(player != null) {
075
076      return player.getUniqueId();
077    }
078    return null;
079  }
080
